title: RustChap concept
description: One teachable skill. Puzzles reference concepts by id in their `concepts` array; the app lists them per puzzle as tap-to-learn lectures (Euclidea-style). The linter (--concepts) verifies every referenced concept exists. File lives at content/concepts/<id>.json.

id.description: Matches the filename and puzzle `concepts` entries.

summary.description: One line shown on the skill row.

lecture.description: Short paragraphs, written for an experienced programmer — the minimum needed to attempt the puzzle, not a course.

code.description: Tiny Rust snippet rendered with syntax highlighting.
